The Fishing Tools & Accessories section brings together what an angler needs besides the rod and lures: tackle boxes, scissors, cutters, crimping pliers, knives and useful extras for fishing, the boat and the car.

FOX boxes come in four models. The Waterproof Storage Box is a waterproof ABS organiser with a neoprene seal around the perimeter, in 27 x 17 x 5.3 and 35.5 x 22 x 5.3 cm. The Double Layers Box is a double-sided box with V-shaped slots for crankbaits. The Fishing Lure Storage Box, 21 x 14.5 x 2.5 cm, has removable dividers and five body colours. SimpleBox is a plain clear box with 5 compartments in three sizes.

Tools. FOX Mini Scissors and FOX Snips Scissors in stainless steel cut mono, braid and soft lures. Side cutters in high-carbon steel with a Teflon coating and crimping pliers for sleeves are what you need when making leaders and rigs. The Bass Pro Shops CP6HOS set combines pliers, scissors and an extractor.

Knives. The FOX Wolf Knife 13 fillet knife in 5Cr15MoV steel and the FOX Butcher Knife cleaver with a forged blade are made for preparing fish and meat.

Accessories. The UA Just Hook It! cap for hot weather, the PIZDUN club patch, Faraday signal-blocking pouches for car keys, the Johnson Pump aerator kit for live bait and the catch, the Worth Anchormate pulley kit for an anchor winch, a switch-off timer and a Bosch IP camera.

Every product page lists dimensions, weight and material, and for FOX boxes you can pick the size or colour right away.
